title: Guard decide-relevance --apply without an explicit doctrine
description: papyrus references decide-relevance --apply defaults --doctrine to corpora/papyrus-publication-doctrine.yml (Threat Intelligence's doctrine), so a sweep for another site silently seeds that site's new cyclotron store with TI's mission (happened to p.apyr.us). Require an explicit --doctrine with --apply; dry run prints the doctrine it would use; guard every other command that seeds from the default.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Started. Branch fix/guard-relevance-doctrine in ../Papyrus-p4a. Auditing callers of load_publication_doctrine_seed to find every default-doctrine path that seeds a store.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Guard implemented with specs (red then green): decide-relevance --apply and decide-site-sections --apply need --doctrine; sections import-doctrine needs --config; dry runs print doctrine path and first mission line. Docs note added incl. relevance-sweep retirement (Ryan, 2026-10-22). Running full local CI next.
